title: Creamy Tomato Ramen Bake
description: A rich and satisfying bake combining the flavors of ramen with a creamy tomato sauce.
instructions: Cook ramen according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add crushed tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low and let cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add cooked ramen to the saucepan and toss to combine with the tomato cream sauce.
Transfer the ramen mixture to a greased 8x8 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle grated Parmesan cheese over the top of the ramen.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped fresh basil, if desired.
Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
